versions.content: If the function LinIf_LinErrorIndication is called, the LIN Interface shall consider the response as lost . Therefore, the LIN Interface shall report the runtime error code LINIF_E_RESPONSE to the Default Error Tracer unless the error code of LinIf_LinErrorIndication is LIN_ERR_HEADER .
